pages.text: The Resonance Chamber is a ritual structure that draws the power of potions into an Unattuned Fork. This creates a Harmonic of Alchemy. It is built from a central Resonance Chamber surrounded by up to four Harmonic Nodes.
Each Harmonic Node can be given a potion to hold. You do not need to fill all four, only the nodes holding a potion will contribute to the ritual.

Right-click the Resonance Chamber with an Unattuned Fork to place it inside. Once the chamber holds a fork and at least one node holds a potion, shift-right-click the chamber with a Nether Star to begin the ritual.$(br2)The chamber will gather energy, then complete the ritual, consuming the stored potions and the Nether Star, leaving behind a Harmonic of Alchemy carrying every potion effect that was offered.
